import hashlib,json,subprocess,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/hot-data/fsx/workspace/erik/orze-paging-package-2026-09-13.ioUQcy08')
base=Path('/hot-data/fsx/workspace/erik/orze-production-validation-2026-09-12.UgS3uV')
result={}
for kind,dirname,commit,package in [('core','orze','cce70af569e748f845c5b0286172f87cfbf9ffe4','orze'),('pro','orze-pro','210fd1b1d7ef2fddd01f47579df050e54f3643b6','orze_pro')]:
 rows=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(base/dirname),'ls-tree','-rz',commit,'--','src/'+package,'pyproject.toml','README.md','LICENSE'])
 expected={}
 for entry in rows.split(b'\0'):
  if not entry:continue
  meta,name=entry.split(b'\t',1);mode,typ,oid=meta.split()
  assert typ==b'blob'
  expected[name.decode()]=oid.decode()
 with tarfile.open(root/(kind+'-source.tar')) as tf:
  members=[m for m in tf.getmembers() if m.isfile()]
  assert {m.name for m in members}==set(expected)
  for m in members:
   b=tf.extractfile(m).read()
   assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()==expected[m.name],m.name
 result[kind]={'commit':commit,'source_archive_blob_count':len(expected),'all_actual_git_blob_objects_exact':True}
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
PY
